content.short: The first NFT Marketplace that feeds the Treasury of a DAO to fund community-driven proposals.
content.description: ALDEA NFT is a Marketplace specifically designed for the Latin American community. We will offer the following functionalities at a very competitive price: - NFT Minting - NFT Publishing - Buy/Sell NFTs All these interactions will generate fees that will go to the ALDEA DAO Treasury. Also, a small part of it will be used for platform support and investment.
